metadata.title: Exploring the impact of ICT interaction on students’ creative thinking across performance levels: an explainable AI perspective

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used average plausible values for the analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses PISA microdata but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without addressing school clustering, which is necessary for proper analysis of ILSA data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as model training and feature analysis but does not indicate any validation on external datasets.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “For multiclass classification, the authors compare Random Forest, LightGBM, and XGBoost under 10-fold cross-validation and internal/external validation; XGBoost is selected as best-performing, with external-validation accuracy around 0.676.”
